title: Supersede Unreal Engine exclusion with optional governed integration

Hardware Audit and fail-closed Hardware Safety Envelope before launch or execution
Software Coexistence and Host Non-Interference: isolated paths, ports, services, environment, caches and GPU resources; never require removal of existing upstream installation
No automatic or silent dependency or provider promotion; CPU-only baseline and alternative 3D workflows remain available
Separate exact-head static gate and physical current-host receipts for runtime, GUI, MCP, interchange and production E2E
Historical exclusion decision and evidence remain immutable; no retrospective PASS
